newsitem.title: UK: London U.S. stocks mixed amid profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: London U.S. stocks mixed amid profit-taking.

text.p: U.S. shares traded here were mixed amid profit-taking on Friday sparked by a stronger dollar, dealers said.
The dollar tested a fresh six-year high against the mark at just above 1.84 marks this morning.
"Shares look ripe for profit-taking to a Swiss investor with the dollar at these levels," said a dealer.
The Dow is expected to open mixed also barring shocks from durable goods orders data due out at 1230 GMT and seen rising 1.4 percent in June.
Any interest rate worries inspired by the data will be capped to a certain extent by calming noises on inflation and rates made this week by Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan.
Corporate features included a $1/4 fall to $59-1/4 for Baxter on doubts on whether the company will get FDA approval for its Isolex 300 stem cell separation system.
Baker Hughes rose $1/4 to $41-9-16 on a report that Frontera Resources and Baker are aiming to join a Unocal-Delta partnership in a development project in Azerbaijan.
